scope: Established width-two block CG control; dense offline action counts, no production timing or novelty claim

protocol.true_checks: every20 iterations, either RHS suspected stop, and final independent primary check
protocol.search_normalization: pivoted Euclidean QR and SVD of width<=2 triangular factor
protocol.recurrence: project preconditioned residual against immediately preceding search block twice; no older history
protocol.deflation: remove auxiliary RHS only after true relative residual<=1e-8; retain previous search block for next conjugation
protocol.memory: exact named retained ndarray backing allocations plus conservative explicitly bounded ndarray workspace; input RHS counted; dense oracle K/A excluded and separately disclosed
protocol.matrix_load_model: each A@block is one possible kernel pass with that many scalar RHS; setup depth passes each width32

runs.memory_count_kind: source-derived seven persistent/check vectors plus one expression vector; not RSS
